payload.purpose_context: Core cannot ask the charter service what is in force until the service stores a project's activation and resolves packs from it. This mission builds the activation register (its document, storage and writes) and roots pack composition at the activated packs, the first steps of ADR-0055's service-first cutover.
payload.purpose_tldr: The charter service records what a project activated and composes only the packs that activation reaches.

options: Document CRUD + closure; per-artifact verbs and presets next mission
payload.question: Which activation writes does this mission build: only create/get/replace/delete (record and read a document), or all nine including select/unselect, deactivate/reactivate and apply-preset?

payload.final_answer: All nine writes now (incl. cascade; requires ruling ADR-0059 OQ2/OQ3 first)

payload.question: ADR-0059 OQ2: scope, timing, deactivate symmetry and provenance of the enhances pull

payload.final_answer: Like the other cascade relations: scoped by cascade kinds (out of scope -> skippedByScope), write-time into selected, symmetric on cascading deactivate, provenance via: enhances (new reason value), requiredBy empty

options: All D2.1 relations, transitive, denied parent stops
payload.question: ADR-0059 OQ3: which relations pass through a specializes_from parent, is it transitive, and what if the parent is denied

payload.final_answer: All D2.1 relations plus the enhances pull, transitive through every ancestor; a denied ancestor stops the walk and is reported in skippedDeactivated

options: Writes validate against the closure; facts on a closure sub-resource
payload.question: Where do the activated-pack closure (#360) and the PackPin depends_on facts (#359) show, given ADR-0059 D5 keeps offering-derived data out of the Activation answer?

payload.final_answer: New GET /activations/{id}/packs sub-read: closure rooted at the activation's packs in dependency order with version and depends_on facts; /offering stays the available catalog; writes and cascade see only the closure (outside -> 422); @WIP scenario rewritten against the new read

payload.question: What does an absent activation key mean in the service now: ADR-0053 d10 'none' or the contract's per-kind default?

payload.final_answer: None, now: absent and [] mean nothing in force for every selected kind, activatedKinds and missionTypes; select adds; kernel InForceWhenAbsent changes; absent packs still means every configured pack; divergence entry until the split

payload.question: Where does the activation domain live: a new activations Gradle module depending on packs, or a package inside packs?

payload.final_answer: Top-level slice over packs: new service/activations module depending on packs, with its own infra.api controller naming generated types; generalize the ArchUnit generated-type rule now (#140)

payload.question: File adapter write safety and concurrency: atomic temp+rename with an in-process per-id lock, multi-process (#349) out of scope?

payload.final_answer: Atomic temp+fsync+atomic move, in-process per-activation-id lock; multi-process stays #349

payload.question: Land this mission as one PR or two stacked PRs (CRUD+storage+closure read, then verbs+cascade+presets)?

payload.final_answer: Two stacked PRs: A = module/slice, storage, CRUD, closure read, contract A; B = select/unselect, deactivate/reactivate, presets, cascade, contract B

options: Governing presets in the closure; locks later
Also build the policy-file reader now
payload.question: Required floor for the 409 refusals: which governing presets bind an activation, and do locks (no policy-file reader yet) come in this mission?

payload.final_answer: Build the mutability policy-file reader in packs now (ADR-0012 D2, ADR-0030) so artifact_locked is proven end to end; required floor = must-have items of every governing preset in the activation's closure (assumed default, flagged to operator)

options: mutability_policy key -> policy.yaml with kind_defaults + artifacts
payload.question: Mutability policy file: descriptor key, file name and shape

payload.final_answer: Optional descriptor key mutability_policy (pack-relative path, e.g. policy.yaml); closed schema policy.schema.json with kind_defaults {kind: level} and artifacts {urn: level}; role locks/pins reserved; named-but-missing/unreadable file makes the pack unreadable; recorded in a new ADR

packs ClosureQueries, one verified closure snapshot
activation CRUD service, controller, body advice and the closure read (green)
apply a preset (scenarios first) and retire the binding pin
packs rooted compose and public closure

activations module skeleton and generalised architecture rules
activation storage (repository port, in-memory and file adapters)
packs typed edges and the reach operation
Documentation and divergences for PR B

contract A and the red scenarios for CRUD and the closure read
